title.en: Varnished orange-brown deck in front of a wall

alt.tr: Gri duvarın önünde döşenmiş cilalı, turuncu-kahverengi ahşap deck zemini
alt.en: Varnished orange-brown timber deck floor laid in front of a grey wall

caption.tr: Tahtalar duvara dik döşenmiş, cila güneşte parlıyor. Duvara yakın kısımda renk biraz daha açık.
caption.en: The boards run at right angles to the wall and the varnish shines in the sun. The colour is a little lighter near the wall.
